name: ngx-super-masonry
description: A high-performance masonry layout library for Angular applications
author: TheDevMohamed

scripts.publish:lib: node scripts/sync-keywords.js && npm run build:lib && cp README.md dist/ngx-super-masonry/ && cd dist/ngx-super-masonry && npm publish --access public
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && cd projects/ngx-super-masonry && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && cd projects/ngx-super-masonry && npm version minor --no-git-tag-version
scripts.publish:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run publish:lib
scripts.publish:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run publish:lib
scripts.build: ng build ngx-super-masonry && ng build demo-app --configuration production --base-href /
